title: Memory costs set PC prices; our store must win AI-led shopping
summary: HP and Dell expect memory prices to keep rising in 2027; PCB shortage lasts to mid-2028. Half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI (NRF); Walmart joined Meta Muse. Adobe: online holiday spend up 9.1% to $82.5B.

points.headline: Memory and PCB shortages will keep PC prices and costs elevated into 2027-28
points.detail: HP and Dell expect memory prices to keep rising in 2027; PCB relief is not seen before mid-2028. Plan inventory, pricing and promotions for tighter supply.

points.headline: AI agents are becoming a deal-discovery and checkout channel
points.detail: Half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI (NRF); Walmart opened Black Friday deals to Meta Muse; Klarna joined Adyen agentic suite. Make our listings and financing agent-readable.

points.headline: Holiday demand is strong online, but value and financing decide tech sales
points.detail: Adobe: online holiday spend up 9.1% to $82.5B; Circana says tech sales hinge on delayed buyers. Lead with value and financing in our store offers.

points.headline: Small-business and computing demand stay resilient despite higher prices
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small business holiday spending; Best Buy computing sales hold on gaming and AI demand. Push business bundles and AI PCs.
